key_insight: Contestable governance makes AI-generated metadata reviewable by preserving cited arguments, human interventions, and final decisions before commit.
engineering_relevance: The approach gives engineers a traceable workflow for governing metadata across structured operational data and unstructured technical documents.
method: Specialist agents propose scored, cited arguments using a versioned domain glossary.
Stewards accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before commit; uncertain proposals receive full argumentation.
Governance records retain evidence and outcomes, while a gate controls which verified decisions become precedent.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes two HVAC use cases—Brick Schema point classification with an open reference implementation and an illustrative warranty failure-mode decision—but reports no quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: Steward review and precedent gating require careful implementation to prevent weakly verified metadata decisions from propagating downstream.
paper_title: Contestable Agents for Data Governance: Recording Human Stewardship of AI-Generated Metadata Across Structured and Unstructured Systems
